contractsSection.heading: Real Schema Contracts Behind the Diagrams
contractsSection.intro: Instead of hoping AI prompts behave, these schemas validate outputs in code. Inspect any file below or open it directly on GitHub.

contracts.caption: Blocks AI hallucinations by forcing every claim to cite verified source hashes and preserve missing values as UNKNOWN.
invariants: Web search disabled during synthesis (web_access: false)
Every claim requires a SHA-256 snapshot hash and source reference
Missing data explicitly stays UNKNOWN or UNAVAILABLE

contracts.caption: Runs offline Vector Embeddings (ONNX) + Keyword Search (Tantivy BM25) together with SHA-256 model integrity verification.
invariants: Combines exact keyword search + 384-d semantic vectors (RRF k=60)
Verifies exact SHA-256 hashes of local ONNX embedding weights
Fails closed instead of silently degrading search quality
